en.text: I structured the narrative using scrollytelling
To achieve this, I used Adobe Premiere Pro and did a frame-by-frame
workflow integrated with HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
While the final modeling results in Blender did not fully satisfy me due to the learning curve and time pressure, it served as a valuable way to gain experience.
